title: Cosmic Omen
html:
This article is about the druid of the stars action. For resource, see Cosmic Omen (resource).

Cosmic Omen is a passive feature that allows Circle of the Stars druids to consult the stars.

Description

Whenever you Long Rest, you consult the stars for a Cosmic Omen of Weal or of Woe. The omen grants you the ability to increase (Weal) or decrease (Woe)  Attack Rolls or  Saving Throws, or (Weal only) to increase your allies' Ability Checks.

Grants:

  •  Cosmic Omen: Ability Check
  •  Cosmic Omen of Weal: Attack Roll
  •  Cosmic Omen of Weal: Saving Throw
  •  Cosmic Omen of Woe: Attack Roll
  •  Cosmic Omen of Woe: Saving Throw

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 6: Circle of the Stars

Notes

  • There is a 50/50 chance each day of gaining either the Weal or Woe abilities, the result being randomly determined after every Long Rest. Thus, it is possible to end up with the same ability set for several consecutive days.
